text: jo: dropped a prototype for dense dashboards. main issues: legend line-wrapping, axis unit switch (K/M) causing misalignment, and an aggressive smoothing preset in the header. feedback? mina: can you attach the frame? jo: https://www.figma.com/file/def variant shows single-line legends with ellipses + compact units, alt shows full numbers but pushes layout. also added a small per-chart smoothing toggle defaulting to ON (we can change). carter: please default smoothing OFF. has bitten us before when users assume plotted values are raw. ada: agreed. Also: compact units are fine visually but we must expose exact values for screen readers and keyboard users. use aria-label with spelled-out numbers, not role=img. jo: sample I used: 1.23M. ok? mina: that's good. add a data-raw attribute with the machine value for support copy/paste. carter: outliers: current mock reduces opacity for spikes. that hides events in usability tests. Better: cap y-axis at a percentile (default 99) and show an overflow badge at chart top-right. clicking badge opens a panel with exact values. microcopy vote: "Reveal outliers" vs "Show full range". ada: "Show full range" reads clearer to me. "Reveal outliers" might sound scary. jo: voice: do emoji vote please. :+1: for "Show full range", :heart: for "Reveal outliers". figma-bot: uploaded image 1741234575 (dense-dashboard-ellipses.png) mina: keyboard/aria: badge must be focusable role=button with aria-expanded and aria-label like "value clipped: twelve million three hundred forty five thousand". panel includes textual table with exact numbers and a toggle to include outliers in chart rendering. carter: visual: instead of dimming, draw clipped spike as dashed truncated line so trend shows. the badge should also show a tiny tooltip "Clipped at 99th percentile". ada: accessibility checklist: 1) compact number has aria-label spelled-out 2) badge focusable + announces full clipped value 3) panel reachable by keyboard and readable by screen readers 4) legend items focusable and show full name on focus. jo: dev notes: 1) default smoothing OFF; make toggle per-chart and persist in localStorage 2) cap percentile configurable (default 99) 3) render dashed truncated spike only for series exceeding cap 4) legend single-line with ellipses, tooltip on hover/focus showing full metric and id 5) copy: use "Show full range" for badge. mina: i'll update frames with dashed truncation + badge state. carter can prototype localStorage toggle behavior. nada will write aria examples. carter: picking up the localStorage + aria-label PR. nada: I'll author a short accessibility snippet and paste it in the design doc. jo: thanks all 49b; will post updated frames by EOD and tag reviewers.
